Govind starts from Point A and walks 18 m towards east. He takes a right turn, walks 14 m and then takes a right turn, walks 11 m and stops at Point B. Pihu starts from Point Y which is 37 m towards the south of Point A. She walks 21 m towards east, takes a left turn, walks 45 m, turns left and walks 14 m and stops at Point Z. What is the shortest distance between Point B and Point Z? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)

A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. D sits third from the right end. Only three people sit between A and D. Only two people sit between A and E. E sits second from the left end. If no other person is sitting in the row, how many people, in total, are sitting in the row?3082

options: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Only conclusion II follows) है।

How many people have exam between P and V?3302

In this question two statements I and II are given. These statements may be independent causes, or effects of independent causes, or effects of a common cause. One of the statements may be the effect of the other statement. Read both the statements and select the correct option.I. The roadwork to replace the underground water pipes in city X is scheduled for tomorrow morning.II. There will be no water supply tomorrow morning to an entire area in city X from 6:00 a.m. to 12 noon.
options: I is the cause and II is its possible effect.
II is the cause and I is its possible effect.
Both I and II are independent causes.
Both I and II are effects of independent causes.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (I is the cause and II is its possible effect.) है।

P, Q, R, S, T and U live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. T lives on an odd numbered floor but not 5. The sum of floors on which T and U live is 5. Only 3 people live between U and P. Q lives immediately above S. How many people live below U?

Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.In row 1 – A, B, C and D are seated and all of them are facing south.In row 2 – P, Q, R and S are seated and all of them are facing north.Thus each person faces another person from the other row.Only three people sit to the right of Q. A faces the person who is the immediate neighbour of R and P. B faces the person sitting second to the right of R. C does not face Q. Who amongst the following faces R?

Some plastics are shoes.II. Some rubbers are jars.
